en.text: On that day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the seaside.

zhSimplified.text: 当那一天，耶稣从房子里出来，坐在海边。

zhTraditional.text: 當那一天，耶穌從房子裏出來，坐在海邊。

en.text: Great multitudes gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat and sat; and all the multitude stood on the beach.

zhSimplified.text: 有许多人到他那里聚集，他只得上船坐下，众人都站在岸上。

zhTraditional.text: 有許多人到他那裏聚集，他只得上船坐下，眾人都站在岸上。

en.text: He spoke to them many things in parables, saying, “Behold, a farmer went out to sow.

zhSimplified.text: 他用比喻对他们讲许多道理，说：「有一个撒种的出去撒种；

zhTraditional.text: 他用比喻對他們講許多道理，說：「有一個撒種的出去撒種；

en.text: Ashe sowed, some seeds fell by the roadside, and the birds came and devoured them.

zhSimplified.text: 撒的时候，有落在路旁的，飞鸟来吃尽了；

zhTraditional.text: 撒的時候，有落在路旁的，飛鳥來吃盡了；

en.text: Othersfell on rocky ground, where they didn’ t have much soil, and immediately they sprang up, because they had no depth of earth.

zhSimplified.text: 有落在土浅石头地上的，土既不深，发苗最快，

zhTraditional.text: 有落在土淺石頭地上的，土既不深，發苗最快，

en.text: Whenthe sun had risen, they were scorched. Because they had no root, they withered away.

zhSimplified.text: 日头出来一晒，因为没有根，就枯干了；

zhTraditional.text: 日頭出來一曬，因為沒有根，就枯乾了；

en.text: Othersfell among thorns. The thorns grew up and choked them.

zhSimplified.text: 有落在荆棘里的，荆棘长起来，把它挤住了；

zhTraditional.text: 有落在荊棘裏的，荊棘長起來，把它擠住了；

en.text: Othersfell on good soil and yielded fruit: some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.

zhSimplified.text: 又有落在好土里的，就结实，有一百倍的，有六十倍的，有三十倍的。

zhTraditional.text: 又有落在好土裏的，就結實，有一百倍的，有六十倍的，有三十倍的。

en.text: Hewho has ears to hear, let him hear.”
The disciples came, and said to him, “Why do you speak to them in parables?”

zhSimplified.text: 门徒进前来，问耶稣说：「对众人讲话，为什么用比喻呢？」

zhTraditional.text: 門徒進前來，問耶穌說：「對眾人講話，為甚麼用比喻呢？」

en.text: He answered them, “Toyou it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣回答说：「因为天国的奥秘只叫你们知道，不叫他们知道。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌回答說：「因為天國的奧祕只叫你們知道，不叫他們知道。

en.text: Forwhoever has, to him will be given, and he will have abundance; but whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he has.

zhSimplified.text: 凡有的，还要加给他，叫他有余；凡没有的，连他所有的，也要夺去。

zhTraditional.text: 凡有的，還要加給他，叫他有餘；凡沒有的，連他所有的，也要奪去。

en.text: ThereforeI speak to them in parables, because seeing they don’t see, and hearing, they don’t hear, neither do they understand.

zhSimplified.text: 所以我用比喻对他们讲，是因他们看也看不见，听也听不见，也不明白。

zhTraditional.text: 所以我用比喻對他們講，是因他們看也看不見，聽也聽不見，也不明白。

en.text: Inthem the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled, which says, ‘Byhearing you will hear, andwill in no way understand; Seeingyou will see, andwill in no way perceive;

zhSimplified.text: 在他们身上，正应了以赛亚的预言，说： 你们听是要听见，却不明白； 看是要看见，却不晓得；

zhTraditional.text: 在他們身上，正應了以賽亞的預言，說： 你們聽是要聽見，卻不明白； 看是要看見，卻不曉得；

en.text: forthis people’s heart has grown callous, theirears are dull of hearing, andthey have closed their eyes; orelse perhaps they might perceive with their eyes, hear withtheir ears, understandwith their heart, andwould turn again, andI would heal them.’

zhSimplified.text: 因为这百姓油蒙了心， 耳朵发沉， 眼睛闭着， 恐怕眼睛看见， 耳朵听见， 心里明白，回转过来， 我就医治他们。

zhTraditional.text: 因為這百姓油蒙了心， 耳朵發沉， 眼睛閉着， 恐怕眼睛看見， 耳朵聽見， 心裏明白，回轉過來， 我就醫治他們。

en.text: “Butblessed are your eyes, for they see; and your ears, for they hear.

zhSimplified.text: 「但你们的眼睛是有福的，因为看见了；你们的耳朵也是有福的，因为听见了。

zhTraditional.text: 「但你們的眼睛是有福的，因為看見了；你們的耳朵也是有福的，因為聽見了。

en.text: Formost certainly I tell you that many prophets and righteous men desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them; and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.

zhSimplified.text: 我实在告诉你们，从前有许多先知和义人要看你们所看的，却没有看见，要听你们所听的，却没有听见。」 （可4·13—20；路8·11—15）

zhTraditional.text: 我實在告訴你們，從前有許多先知和義人要看你們所看的，卻沒有看見，要聽你們所聽的，卻沒有聽見。」 （可4‧13－20；路8‧11－15）

en.text: “Hear, then, the parable of the farmer.

zhSimplified.text: 「所以，你们当听这撒种的比喻。

zhTraditional.text: 「所以，你們當聽這撒種的比喻。

en.text: Whenanyone hears the word of the Kingdom and doesn’ t understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away that which has been sown in his heart. This is what was sown by the roadside.

zhSimplified.text: 凡听见天国道理不明白的，那恶者就来，把所撒在他心里的夺了去；这就是撒在路旁的了。

zhTraditional.text: 凡聽見天國道理不明白的，那惡者就來，把所撒在他心裏的奪了去；這就是撒在路旁的了。

en.text: Whatwas sown on the rocky places, this is he who hears the word and immediately with joy receives it;

zhSimplified.text: 撒在石头地上的，就是人听了道，当下欢喜领受，

zhTraditional.text: 撒在石頭地上的，就是人聽了道，當下歡喜領受，

en.text: yethe has no root in himself, but endures for a while. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately he stumbles.

zhSimplified.text: 只因心里没有根，不过是暂时的，及至为道遭了患难，或是受了逼迫，立刻就跌倒了。

zhTraditional.text: 只因心裏沒有根，不過是暫時的，及至為道遭了患難，或是受了逼迫，立刻就跌倒了。

en.text: Whatwas sown among the thorns, this is he who hears the word, but the cares of this age and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.

zhSimplified.text: 撒在荆棘里的，就是人听了道，后来有世上的思虑、钱财的迷惑把道挤住了，不能结实。

zhTraditional.text: 撒在荊棘裏的，就是人聽了道，後來有世上的思慮、錢財的迷惑把道擠住了，不能結實。

en.text: Whatwas sown on the good ground, this is he who hears the word and understands it, who most certainly bears fruit and produces, some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.”

zhSimplified.text: 撒在好地上的，就是人听道明白了，后来结实，有一百倍的，有六十倍的，有三十倍的。」

zhTraditional.text: 撒在好地上的，就是人聽道明白了，後來結實，有一百倍的，有六十倍的，有三十倍的。」

en.text: He set another parable before them, saying, “TheKingdom of Heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field,

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣又设个比喻对他们说：「天国好像人撒好种在田里，

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌又設個比喻對他們說：「天國好像人撒好種在田裏，

en.text: butwhile people slept, his enemy came and sowed darnel weeds alsoamong the wheat, and went away.

footnotes.text: 13:25 darnel is a weed grass (probably bearded darnel or lolium temulentum) that looks very much like wheat until it is mature, when the difference becomes very apparent.

zhSimplified.text: 及至人睡觉的时候，有仇敌来，将稗子撒在麦子里就走了。

zhTraditional.text: 及至人睡覺的時候，有仇敵來，將稗子撒在麥子裏就走了。

en.text: Butwhen the blade sprang up and produced grain, then the darnel weeds appeared also.

zhSimplified.text: 到长苗吐穗的时候，稗子也显出来。

zhTraditional.text: 到長苗吐穗的時候，稗子也顯出來。

en.text: Theservants of the householder came and said to him, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field? Where did these darnel weeds come from?’

zhSimplified.text: 田主的仆人来告诉他说：『主啊，你不是撒好种在田里吗？从哪里来的稗子呢？』

zhTraditional.text: 田主的僕人來告訴他說：『主啊，你不是撒好種在田裏嗎？從哪裏來的稗子呢？』

en.text: “Hesaid to them, ‘An enemy has done this.’ “Theservants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and gather them up?’

zhSimplified.text: 主人说：『这是仇敌做的。』仆人说：『你要我们去薅出来吗？』

zhTraditional.text: 主人說：『這是仇敵做的。』僕人說：『你要我們去薅出來嗎？』

en.text: “Buthe said, ‘No, lest perhaps while you gather up the darnel weeds, you root up the wheat with them.

zhSimplified.text: 主人说：『不必，恐怕薅稗子，连麦子也拔出来。

zhTraditional.text: 主人說：『不必，恐怕薅稗子，連麥子也拔出來。

en.text: Letboth grow together until the harvest, and in the harvest time I will tell the reapers, “First, gather up the darnel weeds, and bind them in bundles to burn them; but gather the wheat into my barn.”’”

zhSimplified.text: 容这两样一齐长，等着收割。当收割的时候，我要对收割的人说，先将稗子薅出来，捆成捆，留着烧；惟有麦子要收在仓里。』」 （可4·30—32；路13·18—21）

zhTraditional.text: 容這兩樣一齊長，等着收割。當收割的時候，我要對收割的人說，先將稗子薅出來，捆成捆，留着燒；惟有麥子要收在倉裏。』」 （可4‧30－32；路13‧18－21）

en.text: He set another parable before them, saying, “TheKingdom of Heaven is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took, and sowed in his field,

zhSimplified.text: 他又设个比喻对他们说：「天国好像一粒芥菜种，有人拿去种在田里。

zhTraditional.text: 他又設個比喻對他們說：「天國好像一粒芥菜種，有人拿去種在田裏。

en.text: whichindeed is smaller than all seeds. But when it is grown, it is greater than the herbs and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in its branches.”

zhSimplified.text: 这原是百种里最小的，等到长起来，却比各样的菜都大，且成了树，天上的飞鸟来宿在它的枝上。」

zhTraditional.text: 這原是百種裏最小的，等到長起來，卻比各樣的菜都大，且成了樹，天上的飛鳥來宿在它的枝上。」

en.text: He spoke another parable to them. “TheKingdom of Heaven is like yeast which a woman took and hid in three measures ofmeal, until it was all leavened.”

footnotes.text: 13:33 literally, three sata. Three sata is about 39 liters or a bit more than a bushel

zhSimplified.text: 他又对他们讲个比喻说：「天国好像面酵，有妇人拿来，藏在三斗面里，直等全团都发起来。」 （可4·33—34）

zhTraditional.text: 他又對他們講個比喻說：「天國好像麵酵，有婦人拿來，藏在三斗麵裏，直等全團都發起來。」 （可4‧33－34）

en.text: Jesus spoke all these things in parables to the multitudes; and without a parable, he didn’t speak to them,

zhSimplified.text: 这都是耶稣用比喻对众人说的话；若不用比喻，就不对他们说什么。

zhTraditional.text: 這都是耶穌用比喻對眾人說的話；若不用比喻，就不對他們說甚麼。

en.text: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying, “I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the foundation of the world.”

zhSimplified.text: 这是要应验先知的话，说： 我要开口用比喻， 把创世以来所隐藏的事发明出来。

zhTraditional.text: 這是要應驗先知的話，說： 我要開口用比喻， 把創世以來所隱藏的事發明出來。

en.text: Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, “Explain to us the parable of the darnel weeds of the field.”

zhSimplified.text: 当下，耶稣离开众人，进了房子。他的门徒进前来，说：「请把田间稗子的比喻讲给我们听。」

zhTraditional.text: 當下，耶穌離開眾人，進了房子。他的門徒進前來，說：「請把田間稗子的比喻講給我們聽。」

en.text: He answered them, “Hewho sows the good seed is the Son of Man,

zhSimplified.text: 他回答说：「那撒好种的就是人子；

zhTraditional.text: 他回答說：「那撒好種的就是人子；

en.text: thefield is the world, the good seeds are the children of the Kingdom, and the darnel weeds are the children of the evil one.

zhSimplified.text: 田地就是世界；好种就是天国之子；稗子就是那恶者之子；

zhTraditional.text: 田地就是世界；好種就是天國之子；稗子就是那惡者之子；

en.text: Theenemy who sowed them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are angels.

zhSimplified.text: 撒稗子的仇敌就是魔鬼；收割的时候就是世界的末了；收割的人就是天使。

zhTraditional.text: 撒稗子的仇敵就是魔鬼；收割的時候就是世界的末了；收割的人就是天使。

en.text: Astherefore the darnel weeds are gathered up and burned with fire; so will it be at the end of this age.

zhSimplified.text: 将稗子薅出来用火焚烧，世界的末了也要如此。

zhTraditional.text: 將稗子薅出來用火焚燒，世界的末了也要如此。

en.text: TheSon of Man will send out his angels, and they will gather out of his Kingdom all things that cause stumbling and those who do iniquity,

zhSimplified.text: 人子要差遣使者，把一切叫人跌倒的和作恶的，从他国里挑出来，

zhTraditional.text: 人子要差遣使者，把一切叫人跌倒的和作惡的，從他國裏挑出來，

en.text: andwill cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

zhSimplified.text: 丢在火炉里；在那里必要哀哭切齿了。

zhTraditional.text: 丟在火爐裏；在那裏必要哀哭切齒了。

en.text: Thenthe righteous will shine like the sun in the Kingdom of their Father. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

zhSimplified.text: 那时，义人在他们父的国里，要发出光来，像太阳一样。有耳可听的，就应当听！」

zhTraditional.text: 那時，義人在他們父的國裏，要發出光來，像太陽一樣。有耳可聽的，就應當聽！」

en.text: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like treasure hidden in the field, which a man found and hid. In his joy, he goes and sells all that he has and buys that field.

zhSimplified.text: 「天国好像宝贝藏在地里，人遇见了就把它藏起来，欢欢喜喜地去变卖一切所有的，买这块地。

zhTraditional.text: 「天國好像寶貝藏在地裏，人遇見了就把它藏起來，歡歡喜喜地去變賣一切所有的，買這塊地。

en.text: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a merchant seeking fine pearls,

zhSimplified.text: 天国又好像买卖人寻找好珠子，

zhTraditional.text: 天國又好像買賣人尋找好珠子，

en.text: whohaving found one pearl of great price, he went and sold all that he had and bought it.

zhSimplified.text: 遇见一颗重价的珠子，就去变卖他一切所有的，买了这颗珠子。

zhTraditional.text: 遇見一顆重價的珠子，就去變賣他一切所有的，買了這顆珠子。

en.text: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a dragnet that was cast into the sea and gathered some fish of every kind,

zhSimplified.text: 天国又好像网撒在海里，聚拢各样水族，

zhTraditional.text: 天國又好像網撒在海裏，聚攏各樣水族，

en.text: which, when it was filled, fishermen drew up on the beach. They sat down and gathered the good into containers, but the bad they threw away.

zhSimplified.text: 网既满了，人就拉上岸来，坐下，拣好的收在器具里，将不好的丢弃了。

zhTraditional.text: 網既滿了，人就拉上岸來，坐下，揀好的收在器具裏，將不好的丟棄了。

en.text: Soit will be in the end of the world. Theangels will come and separate the wicked from among the righteous,

zhSimplified.text: 世界的末了也要这样。天使要出来，从义人中把恶人分别出来，

zhTraditional.text: 世界的末了也要這樣。天使要出來，從義人中把惡人分別出來，

en.text: andwill cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”

zhSimplified.text: 丢在火炉里；在那里必要哀哭切齿了。」

zhTraditional.text: 丟在火爐裏；在那裏必要哀哭切齒了。」

en.text: Jesus said to them, “Haveyou understood all these things?” They answered him, “Yes, Lord.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「这一切的话你们都明白了吗？」他们说：「我们明白了。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「這一切的話你們都明白了嗎？」他們說：「我們明白了。」

en.text: He said to them, “Thereforeevery scribe who has been made a disciple in the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a householder, who brings out of his treasure new and old things.”

zhSimplified.text: 他说：「凡文士受教作天国的门徒，就像一个家主从他库里拿出新旧的东西来。」 （可6·1—6；路4·16—30）

zhTraditional.text: 他說：「凡文士受教作天國的門徒，就像一個家主從他庫裏拿出新舊的東西來。」 （可6‧1－6；路4‧16－30）

en.text: When Jesus had finished these parables, he departed from there.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说完了这些比喻，就离开那里，

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說完了這些比喻，就離開那裏，

en.text: Coming into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished and said, “Where did this man get this wisdom and these mighty works?

zhSimplified.text: 来到自己的家乡，在会堂里教训人，甚至他们都希奇，说：「这人从哪里有这等智慧和异能呢？

zhTraditional.text: 來到自己的家鄉，在會堂裏教訓人，甚至他們都希奇，說：「這人從哪裏有這等智慧和異能呢？

en.text: Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t his mother called Mary, and his brothers James, Joses, Simon, and Judas?

zhSimplified.text: 这不是木匠的儿子吗？他母亲不是叫马利亚吗？他弟兄们不是叫雅各、约西、西门、犹大吗？

zhTraditional.text: 這不是木匠的兒子嗎？他母親不是叫馬利亞嗎？他弟兄們不是叫雅各、約西 、 西門、猶大嗎？

en.text: Aren’t all of his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all of these things?”

zhSimplified.text: 他妹妹们不是都在我们这里吗？这人从哪里有这一切的事呢？」

zhTraditional.text: 他妹妹們不是都在我們這裏嗎？這人從哪裏有這一切的事呢？」

en.text: They were offended by him. But Jesus said to them, “Aprophet is not without honor, except in his own country and in his own house.”

zhSimplified.text: 他们就厌弃他。耶稣对他们说：「大凡先知，除了本地本家之外，没有不被人尊敬的。」

footnotes.text: - 13:57 厌弃他：原文是因他跌倒

zhTraditional.text: 他們就厭棄他。耶穌對他們說：「大凡先知，除了本地本家之外，沒有不被人尊敬的。」

footnotes.text: - 13:57 厭棄他：原文是因他跌倒

en.text: He didn’t do many mighty works there because of their unbelief.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣因为他们不信，就在那里不多行异能了。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌因為他們不信，就在那裏不多行異能了。
